package main

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

func GetUserEmail(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, userID string) (string, error) {
	var email string
	err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = $1", userID).Scan(&email)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("querying user %s: %w", userID, err)
	}
	return email, nil
}
